archetypes.insight: Extremes come from making all but one coin the same type, so the difference is 2018 swapped coins times 4 cents = 8072.

archetypes.archetype: count unit cubes by painted-face class
archetypes.insight: Two-iced-face cubes are the vertical-edge cubes below the top corners (12) plus the non-corner top-edge cubes (8), totaling 20.

archetypes.archetype: arrangements with a forbidden adjacency (complementary counting)
archetypes.insight: Subtract arrangements with the banned pair glued together: 4! - 2*3! = 12.

archetypes.archetype: average speeds read off a distance-time graph

archetypes.archetype: regroup factorial factors to solve an equation
archetypes.insight: Since 5! = 120 = 12 * 10 and 10 * 9! = 10!, the equation collapses to N = 10.

archetypes.archetype: solve for an added quantity to reach a target ratio

archetypes.archetype: total from mean times count read off a chart

archetypes.archetype: convert a percent equation into a ratio of variables
archetypes.insight: From 0.15x = 0.20y, the ratio y/x = 15/20 = 3/4, so y is 75% of x.

archetypes.archetype: digit-placement puzzle using multiplicity-weighted sums
archetypes.insight: Summing all five line-sums counts each digit once per line through it, so comparing 47 with the base sum 1+...+6 = 21 pins down the digit at the highly-shared point B.

archetypes.archetype: count divisors with a property by excluding small cases
archetypes.insight: Of 2020 = 2^2 * 5 * 101's twelve divisors, only 1, the primes 2, 5, 101, and the prime square 4 have at most 3 factors, leaving 7.

archetypes.archetype: radius-to-corner right triangle in a circle
archetypes.insight: The radius 17 drawn to a top corner forms a right triangle with horizontal leg 8, giving height 15 and area 16 * 15 = 240.

archetypes.archetype: count digit-pattern numbers under divisibility rules
archetypes.insight: Divisibility by 5 forces the pattern 5b5b5 (b != 5), and divisibility by 3 forces 15 + 2b divisible by 3, giving b in {0, 3, 6, 9}.

archetypes.archetype: reconstruct a sequence from integrality and average constraints
archetypes.insight: Since 11 is odd its neighbors must be 22 (halving would break integrality), and only the branch whose sum is 1 mod 5 yields an average ending in .2, namely 24.2.

archetypes.archetype: lattice path counting with boundary constraints (Pascal fill-in)

archetypes.archetype: work backwards through a branching iterated rule
archetypes.insight: Invert the even-halve / odd-triple-plus-one rule from 1 for six steps, branching into times-2 and (n-1)/3 predecessors, and sum the valid starting values to get 83.

archetypes.archetype: count onto distributions of distinct items (surjections)
archetypes.insight: Split into award-count patterns (3,1,1) and (2,2,1) — or use inclusion-exclusion 3^5 - 3*2^5 + 3 — to get 150.

archetypes.archetype: area fraction to length ratio via square roots
archetypes.insight: Gray covering 64% = 0.8^2 of the area means 24s = 0.8(24s + 25d) in side lengths, so d/s = 6/25.

archetypes.archetype: label composite-figure side lengths and solve linear equations
archetypes.insight: Labeling the outer squares a and b makes the width a + s + b and the height a + b - s, so their difference 1302 equals 2s and s = 651.
